desc:
A sealed basin broke open and a living Mesozoic world spilled out. The Trust can't fence it, so it licenses hunters.

Read the wind. Follow footprints and blood. Glass a herd from a ridge, then close in on the one animal you came for. Every dinosaur is an individual, with its own weight, age and temperament, and every wound leaves a trail that leads back to that animal.

• 17 dinosaur species to hunt or tranquilize, from Gallimimus to Tyrannosaurus, plus smaller wildlife
• 5 reserves: Kettle Hollow, Blackwater Fen, Ochre Mesa, Thornveil Canopy and Ashfall Caldera
• 14 weapons, rifles to longbow, crossbow and tranquilizer: drop, energy and shot placement count
• Day, dusk, night and weather change what you can see and what can hear you
• Predators hunt the herds too, and they come to investigate a gunshot
• Permits from Trainee to Primeval: sharper senses and bigger scores
• Trophies, rare colors, challenges and leaderboards

Patience pays. Clean shots score highest.
